# Set-ZbxRegExp

## SYNOPSIS

Changes a global regular expression.

## SYNTAX

```
Set-ZbxRegExp [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixRegExp>[]> [[-Name] <string>] [-TestString <string>] [-Expression <ZabbixRegExpExpressionRequest[]>] [-Description <string>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-PassThru] [-PipedRecord <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A global regular expression is a named set of expressions that log items, low-level discovery filters and other fields refer to as @name. The Set-ZbxRegExp cmdlet changes the global regular expressions given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped objects) with regexp.update; a field whose parameter is not given keeps its value. Every global regular expression the pipeline brings is changed in one call when the pipeline ends, and -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name. The command writes nothing unless -PassThru is given, which reads the changed global regular expressions back and writes them; -WhatIf shows what would change.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Change a global regular expression

```powershell
Set-ZbxRegExp -InputObject 'Application errors' -TestString '2026-01-01 12:00:00 ERROR payment failed'
```

Sets the text the frontend tests the global regular expression Application errors against.

### Example 2: Change a global regular expression and write the result

```powershell
Set-ZbxRegExp -InputObject 'Application errors' -TestString '2026-01-01 12:00:00 ERROR payment failed' -PassThru
```

The same change with -PassThru, which reads the global regular expression Application errors back from the server and writes it; without it the command writes nothing.

## INPUTS

- `ZabbixReference<ZabbixRegExp>[]`: Bound to -InputObject (ByValue). Represents a reference to an API object: a parameter that points at an API object takes its id, its name, or the object itself piped from a Get- cmdlet, and becomes an id before the call — one parameter, three spellings, one resolution.
- `string`: Bound to -Name (ByPropertyName), -TestString (ByPropertyName), -Description (ByPropertyName). Text.
- `ZabbixRegExpExpressionRequest[]`: Bound to -Expression (ByPropertyName). expressions of a ZabbixRegExpCreateRequest.
- `PSObject`: Bound to -PipedRecord (ByValue). Each object as the API answers it.

## OUTPUTS

- `ZabbixRegExp`: Reg exp class.
